findings.title: VLAN/Trunk Detection completed with warnings
findings.detail: No 802.1Q tagged frames were observed during the passive capture window. The port may be configured as an untagged access port. No CDP or LLDP neighbour frames were received in the 65s capture window. The upstream switch may have neighbour discovery disabled on this port, or it may be a non-Cisco/non-standard device.

findings.title: DNS services were detected on the local network
findings.detail: The DNS scan identified 6 host(s) with DNS-related ports open.

findings.title: Active Directory / LDAP services detected on the local network
findings.detail: The LDAP/AD scan identified 1 host(s) with directory service ports open (Kerberos, LDAP, LDAPS, or Global Catalog). Confirm these are expected domain controllers for this site.

findings.title: NFS shares exposed on the network
findings.detail: 1 host(s) have NFS (port 2049) accessible: 10.1.1.9. NFS without strict host-based access controls allows any network host to attempt to mount available shares.

findings.title: SMB signing not required on one or more hosts
findings.detail: 10 host(s) with SMB (port 445) do not enforce signing: 10.1.1.9, 10.1.1.11, 10.1.1.51, 10.1.1.52, 10.1.1.171, 10.1.1.180, 10.1.1.183, 10.1.1.189, 10.1.1.196, 10.1.1.218. Without mandatory signing, SMB traffic is vulnerable to relay and man-in-the-middle attacks.

findings.title: Printers with unauthenticated JetDirect port exposed
findings.detail: 3 of 3 printer(s) have port 9100 (JetDirect/raw printing) open: 10.1.1.51, 10.1.1.52, 10.1.1.218. This port accepts print jobs without authentication and can be used to retrieve previously printed documents on some models.
